def parse_pair_text(msg, n):
    lines=msg.splitlines()
    a=lines.index(f'Demo pair {n} input (28x28):')+1
    b=lines.index(f'Demo pair {n} output (28x28):')
    inp=[[int(x) for x in line.split()] for line in lines[a:b]]
    out=[[int(x) for x in line.split()] for line in lines[b+1:b+29]]
    return inp,out
